name: pyecos
description: Read Bank of Korea ECOS economic statistics from the command line, powered by the pyecos CLI

interface.shortDescription: Read Bank of Korea ECOS economic statistics
interface.longDescription: Fetch a statistic's time series, browse the statistical-table catalog to find its codes, or read the top-100 headline indicators from the Bank of Korea ECOS Open API via the pyecos CLI. Needs a free ECOS API key in ECOS_API_KEY.
defaultPrompt: Get the Bank of Korea base rate as a monthly series
Find the ECOS table code for the consumer price index
